item.title: Indonesia: Strengthening Child Protection in the Digital Era
item.description: Indonesia is intensifying efforts to protect children online through strict regulations, family-focused measures and coordinated actions against digital threats nationwide, ensuring safer digital environments.

item.title: Hong Kong: HKUST Develops Ultra-Low-Loss On-Chip Photodetector
item.description: HKUST researchers have developed a germanium-implanted silicon photodiode enabling precise, low-loss on-chip monitoring for scalable and energy-efficient programmable photonic systems.

item.title: Vietnam: Fostering Innovation-Led Sustainable Development
item.description: Resolution 57 is a key enabler for removing institutional bottlenecks and positioning science, technology and innovation at the centre of Vietnam’s sustainable and inclusive long-term national development strategy.

item.title: Thailand: Accelerating Digital Government and Enhancing Data Security
item.description: Thailand advances its digital government and significantly strengthens personal data protection through nationwide e-Office adoption under GDCC and DGA’s ISO/IEC 27701:2019 certification.

item.title: Malaysia: Tech, Innovation Drive Smart Pineapple Strategy
item.description: The Malaysian Pineapple Industry Board is leveraging technology, innovation, and commercialisation under 13MP to boost downstream processing, create high-value products, and enhance global competitiveness.

item.title: India, New Zealand Strengthen Fintech and Financial Innovation Ties
item.description: The India-New Zealand landmark Financial Services Annexe, under their FTA, boosts fintech, digital payments, cross-border innovation and market access for financial services providers.

item.title: Vietnam: Early Detection Crucial to Ensure Financial Security
item.description: Early detection, proactive measures and close inter-agency coordination are absolutely essential to safeguard Vietnam’s financial system from evolving cyber threats and high-tech crimes in the digital age.

item.title: Hong Kong: CityUHK Expands Digital Health Research
item.description: CityUHK’s Institute of Digital Medicine is advancing Hong Kong’s digital healthcare ecosystem by strengthening health data collaboration, AI-driven research and cross-sector partnerships across the wider region.

item.title: Indonesia: Driving Digital Trade and Innovation by Easing Investment
item.description: The Debottlenecking Task Force underscores Indonesia’s focus on simplifying business processes by aligning regulatory reform with digital trade, technology and innovation-driven investment.
